zh.title: Thermal Lab
zh.subtitle: 液冷服务器智能热管理平台
zh.discipline: 系统工程 / 数字孪生
zh.summary: 连接实验设备、实时数据与三维场景，让液冷系统的运行状态更容易理解。
zh.status: 持续开发中的研究平台
zh.question: 如何把设备采集、运行监测、实验数据和辅助问答组织为一个可理解、可追溯的工作环境？
contributions: 整合设备与测点、实时监测、历史查询和研究数据导出。
将三维场景与设备状态结合，组织多通道信息与交互。
接入文字及语音助手，配合操作确认和可读证据。
zh.result: 整合采集、监测和三维展示等功能，平台持续迭代；模型精度与实机控制效果仍需单独验证。
zh.caption: 平台结构示意 · 按功能重新绘制

en.title: Thermal Lab
en.subtitle: Intelligent thermal management for liquid-cooled servers
en.summary: Connecting experimental hardware, live data, and a spatial view to make cooling systems easier to understand.
en.question: How can device acquisition, monitoring, experimental records, and assisted inquiry become one understandable, traceable workspace?
contributions: Integrated device and signal catalogues, monitoring, history, and research data export.
Connected a 3D scene with equipment state and organised multi-channel information.
Integrated text and voice assistance with operation confirmation and readable evidence.
en.result: Integrated acquisition, monitoring, and 3D presentation in an evolving research platform. Model accuracy and physical-control performance require further validation.
en.caption: Platform concept · Redrawn from its functional structure

zh.title: Liquid Cooling Benchmark
zh.subtitle: 可复现的数据中心液冷建模与控制实验
zh.discipline: 物理建模 / 控制实验
zh.summary: 从冷板到机柜与冷源，用统一的模型边界连接物理系统与外部控制方法。
zh.question: 如何建立层次清晰、可验证的数据中心液冷被控对象，使不同控制方法能够在一致条件下比较？
contributions: 组织冷板、服务器、机柜、CDU 与冷源等分层 Modelica 模型。
通过 FMU 暴露控制接口，连接 Python 驱动、场景和后处理。
建立组件验证、基线矩阵与参数来源记录，保留模型适用边界。
zh.result: 形成从物理模型、FMU 接口到控制实验与结果整理的研究链路。当前工作属于持续验证中的研究项目。
zh.caption: 液冷系统拓扑示意 · 非实测数据

en.title: Liquid Cooling Benchmark
en.subtitle: Reproducible modelling and control experiments
en.summary: A consistent boundary between physical cooling systems and external controllers, from cold plates to racks and cooling plants.
en.question: How can a hierarchical, verifiable liquid-cooling plant support comparisons of controllers under consistent conditions?
contributions: Organised hierarchical Modelica models for cold plates, servers, racks, CDUs, and the cooling plant.
Exposed FMU control interfaces to Python drivers, scenarios, and post-processing.
Established component checks, baseline matrices, and parameter provenance with explicit model boundaries.
en.result: A research workflow connecting physical models, FMU interfaces, control experiments, and result analysis. Verification is ongoing.
en.caption: Cooling-system concept · No measured data shown

zh.title: Learning the Wake
zh.subtitle: 漂浮式风力机尾流与神经网络预测
zh.discipline: 科学机器学习 / 风能
zh.summary: 将物理解析模型与神经网络结合，探索风力机尾流场的代理预测。
zh.question: 如何利用已有 CFD 数据与物理先验，提高风力机尾流场预测的效率？
contributions: 基于 CFD 尾流数据搭建耦合物理解析模型的卷积代理模型。
使用 PyTorch 探索预训练微调、自监督学习等训练策略。
比较预测效果与计算成本，检验代理模型的有效性。
zh.result: 项目获第十八届全国大学生节能减排社会实践与科技竞赛三等奖，完成物理先验与数据驱动相结合的尾流代理预测阶段研究。
zh.caption: 尾流场概念图 · 示意流线，不表示仿真结果

en.title: Learning the Wake
en.subtitle: Neural surrogate modelling for floating wind-turbine wakes
en.summary: Bringing physical priors and neural networks together to explore faster predictions of turbine wake fields.
en.question: How can CFD data and physical priors support more efficient predictions of wind-turbine wake fields?
contributions: Built a convolutional surrogate coupled with a physical analytical model using CFD wake data.
Explored pretraining, fine-tuning, and self-supervised strategies in PyTorch.
Compared prediction quality and computational cost to assess the surrogate approach.
en.result: The project received Third Prize in the 18th National University Energy Conservation & Emission Reduction Competition, completing a research stage in physics-informed surrogate prediction of turbine wakes.
en.caption: Wake-field concept · Illustrative streamlines, not simulation output

zh.title: 灵感边框
zh.subtitle: 原生 Android 照片编辑与导出工具
zh.summary: 以统一场景模型连接模板、EXIF、文字水印与原图导出，所有编辑在设备本地完成。
zh.status: 开源原生应用 · 持续迭代
zh.question: 如何在流畅的移动编辑体验与大尺寸照片的可靠导出之间，保持版式、色彩和元数据处理的一致性？
contributions: 使用 Kotlin / Jetpack Compose 构建原生编辑器，整合模板、边框、EXIF 与多图层文字水印。
以共享场景模型连接预览与导出，结合分区解码、条带编码处理大尺寸照片。
实现本地草稿、预设和串行批量任务；支持中英双语，默认移除导出照片的 GPS 与设备序列号。
zh.result: 2.0 系列源码公开，已形成原生编辑、色彩管理与批量导出链路。仓库保留界面快照和设备验收记录；HDR 等能力受 Android 版本、设备和编辑模式约束。
zh.caption: 原生编辑器 Compose 界面快照 · 来自公开仓库，内含示例图片

en.title: Photo Frame Studio
en.subtitle: Native Android photo editing & export
en.summary: A shared scene model connects templates, EXIF, text layers, and full-resolution export. Editing stays on the device.
en.question: How can a responsive mobile editor preserve layout, colour, and metadata decisions when exporting large photographs?
contributions: Built a native Kotlin / Jetpack Compose editor for templates, borders, EXIF, and layered text and watermarks.
Connected preview and export through a shared scene model, with region decoding and strip encoding for large photos.
Implemented local drafts, presets, and serial batch tasks; added Chinese and English, with GPS and device serials removed from exports by default.
en.result: The 2.0 source is public, covering native editing, colour management, and batch export. The repository includes UI snapshots and device acceptance records. HDR support depends on Android version, hardware, and editing mode.
en.caption: Native Compose UI snapshot · From the public repository, with a sample image

zh.title: Flexible Power
zh.subtitle: 适应可再生能源消纳的智能运行控制
zh.discipline: 能源系统 / 优化控制
zh.summary: 面向高灵活电源，结合设备模型、运行指令与经济性进行参数优化。
zh.role: 共同一作 · 算法与界面开发
zh.status: 竞赛项目 · 已登记软件著作权
zh.question: 当可再生能源出力变化时，如何协调发电与储能设备的运行？
contributions: 以面向对象的方式对锅炉、燃气轮机、电池与蓄热器建模。
采用双层粒子群算法，结合 AGC 指令、风电与设备状态进行优化。
参与算法与前端界面开发，将运行策略呈现为可操作的软件。
zh.result: 获清华大学第四十二届“挑战杯”二等奖、第十八届能源动力设计大赛二等奖，并登记软件著作权。
zh.caption: 多设备协同示意 · 非实际调度数据

en.title: Flexible Power
en.subtitle: Intelligent operation for renewable-energy integration
en.summary: Coordinating equipment models, operational signals, and economic considerations for flexible power systems.
en.question: How can generation and storage respond together as renewable power output changes?
contributions: Modelled boilers, gas turbines, batteries, and heat accumulators with an object-oriented approach.
Applied two-level particle swarm optimisation using AGC instructions, wind generation, and equipment state.
Contributed algorithms and a front-end interface to make operating strategies usable.
en.result: Second Prize in both the 42nd Tsinghua Challenge Cup and the 18th Energy & Power Design Competition, with registered software copyright.
en.caption: Equipment-coordination concept · No operational data shown

zh.title: 小鹤打字通
zh.subtitle: 让双拼练习，多一点及时反馈
zh.discipline: 桌面软件 / 学习工具
zh.summary: 带有双拼键位提示、实时纠错与练习统计的 Qt 桌面软件。
zh.role: 合作开发 · 与包戴宁共同完成
zh.question: 如何帮助初学者在真实输入中建立小鹤双拼的键位记忆？
contributions: 共同开发 C++ / Qt 桌面打字练习应用。
实现文本导入、输入对比、计时与练习统计。
通过双拼键位高亮和错误提示提供即时反馈。
zh.result: 形成可运行的课程作品，仓库公开；作者为段培耀与包戴宁。
zh.caption: 键位提示概念图 · 非应用运行截图

en.title: Flypy Typing
en.subtitle: A little more feedback for every keystroke
en.summary: A Qt typing-practice application with Flypy key hints, immediate corrections, and practice statistics.
en.question: How can new learners build muscle memory for Flypy double-pinyin through actual typing?
contributions: Co-developed a desktop typing-practice application in C++ and Qt.
Implemented text import, input comparison, timing, and practice statistics.
Provided immediate feedback through key highlights and error indicators.
en.result: A runnable course project with public source. Jointly authored by Peiyao Duan and Daining Bao.
en.caption: Key-hint concept · Not an application screenshot

zh.title: TexasJev
zh.subtitle: 规则、联机交互与 AI 决策的实验
zh.discipline: 全栈开发 / AI 实验
zh.summary: 一个六席娱乐筹码牌桌，将确定性规则引擎、状态同步和 Jev 机器人连接起来。
zh.status: 开源实验 · 多设备实测仍有待完成
zh.question: 如何让确定性的牌局规则与不确定的 AI 决策，在多人交互中保持清晰边界？
contributions: 实现牌局规则、合法动作、边池与结算等确定性逻辑。
组织 WebSocket 状态同步、身份隔离、重连与服务端保存。
接入 Jev 机器人，并对模型失败提供明确的本地替代动作。
zh.result: 已形成原记牌工具及联机牌桌，并保留协议与测试记录。仅使用娱乐筹码；多台物理设备连续对局验收仍待完成。
zh.caption: 牌桌与状态流概念图 · 非运行截图

en.title: TexasJev
en.subtitle: An experiment in rules, multiplayer interaction, and AI
en.summary: A six-seat play-chip table connecting a deterministic rules engine, synchronised state, and Jev bots.
en.question: How can deterministic game rules and uncertain AI decisions maintain clear boundaries in a multiplayer system?
contributions: Implemented game rules, legal actions, side pots, and settlement.
Organised WebSocket synchronisation, isolated player views, reconnection, and server persistence.
Integrated Jev bots with explicit local fallback actions when model calls fail.
en.result: A recording tool and multiplayer table with protocol and test records. Play chips only; sustained testing across physical devices remains pending.
en.caption: Table & state-flow concept · Not a running-application screenshot
